comment:
* Displays and detects the user's unlock attempt, which is a drag of a finger
 * across 9 regions of the screen.
 *
 * Is also capable of displaying a static pattern in "in progress", "wrong" or
 * "correct" states.

variables.name: ASPECT_SQUARE
variables.comment: View will be the minimum of width/height

variables.name: ASPECT_LOCK_WIDTH
variables.comment: Fixed width; height will be minimum of (w,h)

variables.name: ASPECT_LOCK_HEIGHT
variables.comment: Fixed height; width will be minimum of (w,h)

variables.name: MILLIS_PER_CIRCLE_ANIMATING
variables.comment:
* How many milliseconds we spend animating each circle of a lock pattern
     * if the animating mode is set.  The entire animation should take this
     * constant * the length of the pattern to complete.

variables.name: DRAG_THRESHHOLD
variables.comment:
* This can be used to avoid updating the display for very small motions or noisy panels.
     * It didn't seem to have much impact on the devices tested, so currently set to 0.

variables.name: mPatternDrawLookup
variables.comment:
* Lookup table for the circles of the pattern we are currently drawing.
     * This will be the cells of the complete pattern unless we are animating,
     * in which case we use this to hold the cells we are drawing for the in
     * progress animation.

variables.name: mInProgressX
variables.comment:
* the in progress point:
     * - during interaction: where the user's finger is
     * - during animation: the current tip of the animating line
